name: King Skelly III
about: The king of the underworld. He climbed every throne in Gehennom, got bored, and climbed out with the three Realm Daggers; now he holds the Castle above hell's gate. Placed on the Castle's throne (tools/patch_engine.py WEB_HOOK_SKELLY), never generated at random. A skeleton who's a king: a little tougher than Vlad, nowhere near the Riders (no regeneration, one weapon attack and a cold touch).
